subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the public meeting-browser permission API ship as a breaking required `meetingUrl` parameter, or should origin-aware permissions be introduced additively for existing external plugins?
rationale: This is a published Plugin SDK surface: choosing whether existing implementations may break is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision, not a mechanical cleanup choice.

options.title: Introduce an additive origin-aware permission hook
options.body: Keep the existing permission-plan call available and prefer a new URL-aware hook when implemented, with documented deprecation timing for the legacy hook.

options.title: Approve a breaking SDK change
options.body: Require all external meeting-platform plugins to adopt `meetingUrl` now and publish an explicit upgrade notice and compatibility rationale.

recommendation.title: Introduce an additive origin-aware permission hook
recommendation.body: Keep the existing permission-plan call available and prefer a new URL-aware hook when implemented, with documented deprecation timing for the legacy hook.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged Teams/meeting-browser feature and authored the proposed Plugin SDK contract update.
